2122140864126341562.en_summary: Hospitals/Clinics need to do a couple things. 1. Know your profitability, including overhead, of every plan. Don’t be desperate and think it’s your only source of patient flow. 2. Self insured employers pay for 71 pct of emps who get insurance via work. Look at your claims by employer, and see which self insured companies are already using you. Aggregate that data in totals only (we did X hip replacements, Y - MRIs etc. then 3. Go to them and tell them how much they spend with you and how they can save a lot of money if they direct contract.
2122140864126341562.zh_summary: 醫院/診所需要做幾件事。1. 了解每個計劃的盈利能力，包括間接費用。不要絕望並認為這是你唯一的患者來源。2. 自保雇主支付71%通過工作獲得保險的員工。查看你的雇主索賠，看看哪些自保公司已經在使用你。只在總數中聚合數據（我們做了X次髖關節置換，Y次MRI等。然後3. 去找他們並告訴他們他們在你這裡花了多少錢，以及如果他們直接簽約如何節省很多錢。
